LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 2.1.2 NEWS TELLING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Observing and Articulating signs 2.1.2 News telling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 2.1.2 News telling, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which things do you see on your way to school? 2. What do we do when not in school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 2.1.2 News telling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Observing keenly and actively as learner tells as they sign and listens to watches

news.

● Self-efficacy: as learner confidently tells news in class.

Values

● Love: Hospitality as learner accepts others’ ideas as they tell news.

● Respect: Patience as learner appreciates opinions of others while telling news.

PCIs

Social cohesion as learner learns the importance of neighbours.
